ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Has_Qualified_Activity__c = FALSE, OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost") ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", Region__c <> "Brazil" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please log a customer interaction (Call, Meeting, or Email) on this Opportunity before closing it as Won or Lost.
